Manacher.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the object by storing the provided input string on the instance." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> input_string </REF>: any "The value to store as the instance input string."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: None "This initializer returns no value."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the provided input_string to the instance field self.input_string. RESULT self.input_string]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Manacher.palindromic_length:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Recursively expands a mirrored character comparison around a center index and returns the palindrome radius length, stopping immediately when the expansion goes out of bounds or characters differ." palindromic_length]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance used to call the recursive method."
        <REF> center </REF>: integer "Center index used as the symmetry anchor for expansion."
        <REF> diff </REF>: integer "Current offset from the center used to compare mirrored positions."
        <REF> string </REF>: string "Input sequence whose symmetric characters are compared."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: integer "Returns 0 when expansion fails at a boundary or mismatch, otherwise returns 1 plus the recursively computed palindromic length for the next outward offset."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether the left mirrored index is before the start of the string, the right mirrored index is at the string length boundary, or the mirrored characters at center - diff and center + diff do not match, using left-to-right short-circuit evaluation. RESULT boundary_or_mismatch_check]
            [COMMAND If any of those failure conditions is true, return 0 immediately to stop the expansion. RESULT 0]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, return 1 plus the result of recursively calling palindromic_length with the same center, diff increased by 1, and the same string. RESULT recursive_length]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Manacher.palindromic_string:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Build a delimiter-separated version of the input string, find the longest palindrome center using the helper length function, and reconstruct the corresponding palindrome while removing delimiter characters." palindromic_string]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self.input_string </REF>: string "Source string to analyze for the longest palindromic substring."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: string "The longest palindromic substring reconstructed without separator characters."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize max_length to 0 and create empty strings new_input_string and output_string. RESULT max_length, new_input_string, output_string]
            [COMMAND Build new_input_string by iterating over all characters in self.input_string except the last one, appending each character followed by a pipe separator, then append the final character without a trailing separator. RESULT new_input_string]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over every index i in new_input_string, call self.palindromic_length(i, 1, new_input_string) to compute the palindrome length centered at or expanded from i. RESULT length]
            [COMMAND Within the same loop, if the computed length is strictly greater than max_length, update max_length to that length and record the current index i as start. RESULT max_length, start]
            [COMMAND After the scan completes, iterate over the slice of new_input_string from start - max_length through start + max_length inclusive and append every character that is not a pipe separator to output_string. RESULT output_string]
            [COMMAND Return output_string as the final reconstructed palindromic substring. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
